stem: Meena stands near a window in her classroom on a sunny morning. Sunlight falls on the wall behind her. Which of these objects, held between the window and the wall, will form the darkest shadow on the wall?

options.text: a thin plastic ruler held edgewise, letting most light pass
a thick wooden book that blocks all the light falling on it
a piece of tracing paper that lets some light pass

teacher.key_rationale: A shadow is darkest where the object completely blocks light from reaching the screen. The thick wooden book is fully opaque and blocks all light, so it casts the darkest shadow; glass and tracing paper transmit light, and the edgewise ruler blocks very little, so their shadows are faint or absent.
